run_prepare_locomotion_dataset: run the script to download and prepare the Holden et al. locomotion dataset as a compressed npz file
run_process_bvh_files: run the script to process BVH motion capture files into root trajectories and quaternion rotations
run_extract_motionsynth_data: run the script to download, extract, and convert the MotionSynth dataset to numpy format

review_get_files_function: review the get_files function that lists BVH files in a directory excluding rest.bvh
